outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of pseudocoloured micrographs/time-lapse images of cells, not a plot showing averaged quantitative data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.

The main graphs plot normalized intensity vs. time as dense scatter of individual measured points (raw kinetic trace from the circled regions in A) rather than a single averaged value, and the fitted curves are overlaid on top of this raw data rather than replacing it. The insets, which zoom into the early time points, likewise show numerous discrete data points (with error bars) across the short time window rather than collapsing the data into single summary values, so the underlying point-by-point data remain visible.
